title: Quantification of Cell Death and Cytotoxicity Using LDH-Glo™ Cytotoxicity Assay
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Thaw stored samples and mix gently.
1. Measure luminescence using a plate reader.

steps.title: Harvest and store conditioned media
steps.instruction: Collect and preserve conditioned media from cell cultures for later analysis.

substeps.instruction: Collect 2 μL of conditioned media from each well.
Dilute the collected media in 298 μL of storage buffer (200 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.3, 10% glycerol, 1% BSA).

steps.title: Perform LDH assay
steps.instruction: Quantify cytotoxicity using the LDH-Glo™ assay following manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Thaw stored samples and mix gently.
Transfer 50 μL of each diluted sample into a 96-well plate.
Add 50 μL of LDH detection reagent to each well (1:1 ratio).
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
